verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.lorikeetcx.ai (HTTP 200) that links to markdown (.md) versions of the docs, such as the MCP server page, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs. The skills docs also expose agent-invocable commands like /lorikeet:create-simulations. The visible llms.txt content looks narrow, centred on the MCP reference section. Missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt covers the full product docs, an llms-full.txt or similar comprehensive agent-oriented bundle, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs.
